messages:
Grace L: Hey @People Ops — Eid al-Fitr fell during the infra maintenance blackout (May 3May 4) and I was on the critical deploy team. Couldn't take the holiday. Is there a way to carry it over or convert it to a religious floating day? cc @Omar Q
People Ops: Hi Grace short answer: yes, we handle religious observance days missed during mandatory blackouts via the blackout-exception flow. For full-time employees we can either add a floating religious day to your next leave year or, in some locations, offer a payroll payout if local law or payroll timing requires it. Manager confirmation + blackout-exception form required.
Grace L: Thanks. I'm FT (exempt). Any tax implications if we payout?
People Ops: For exempt salaried staff a small one-time payout is possible but it will be taxed as supplemental income per local payroll rules. If you'd prefer no tax hit, choose carryover -> floating religious day in the form.
Omar Q: I can confirm Grace was on the deploy and couldn't step away. I'll add a manager note and sign. :+1:
People Ops: Thanks Omar. Please fill the form at https://intranet.redwood/hr-forms/blackout-exception and in "reason" pick "religious_observance". Attach Omar's confirmation. Policy excerpt for quick ref:
```
Blackout exceptions (excerpt):
- Company statutory/religious holidays that fall in mandatory blackout windows may be carried over or paid out if employee reasonably could not take them due to business-critical coverage.
- Approvals require manager confirmation and HR sign-off; payroll cutoffs may apply to payouts.
- Carryover cap: standard policy caps apply (1 statutory day), but religious observance days may be made exception with HR approval in documented cases.
```
People Ops: We've opened case HR-2026-9123 to track this. If you want carryover -> select "floating day"; if you want payout -> select "payout" and include desired payroll run. Payroll timing note below.
Payroll Bot: FYI payroll cutoff for May adjustments is Apr 20. Payout requests received after that may roll to the next cycle.
calendar-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance blackout May 2-5. See https://calendar.redwood/blackouts
Grace L: Submitted the form and attached Omar's manager note. Chose "floating day" and marked urgent (travel plans around next Eid).
People Ops: Received. We'll validate and apply the floating religious day to your leave balance. Because this is a religious observance and documented coverage prevented time off, HR has flagged for expedited review; expect confirmation and balance update in 2-4 business days. :white_check_mark:
Grace L: Amazing, thank you so much!
People Ops: Closing note: if a country requires payout for statutory religious holidays, we'll follow local law and notify you before processing. If an exception to the carryover cap is needed we'll route to Benefits lead for approval and document the rationale in HR-2026-9123.
